dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: We've been fighting here for a while now.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Paimon's starting to wonder if we should've left the ley line deposit alone... Maybe then, the monsters would have stopped coming...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Also, Paimon still doesn't have a clue what's going on here... Shall we just go ask Diluc?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: #Yeah, c'mon, let's get back to the Dawn Winery, {NICKNAME}.
